externalParameters.channels: a family of PPT channels P_d paired with the 50% erasure channel A_2d, and Smith and Yard's pair (arXiv:0807.4935); no hardware input is needed to check any certificate

claims.certificates: every n-use lower bound is an exact certificate in Q(sqrt d) or exact rationals, bound by sha256 to the code and decoder bytes it proved, and re-proved by the shipped generator

explicitlyNotClaimed: that any device superactivates: the hardware runs are an outlook, and the recorded device run is below 3/4
the onset for Smith and Yard's pair: a certified code bounds n* from above, it does not fix it
that the see-saw producers re-run from this bundle: they need an SDP solver it does not pin; their outputs are what is checked

unattestableFiles.why: a statement cannot carry its own digest; SHA256SUMS is written after the statement and is what covers it
